title: fussball.de import – Kaderblick documentation

hero.heading: fussball.de import
hero.lead: The browser extension transfers the currently open fussball.de page to Kaderblick. Before applying anything, you review teams, players, matches and match events in an import draft.

body:
Import history

fussball.de imports shows each import with its number, source, status, record count, creation time and last modification time.

  • Refresh reloads the history.
  • Browser extension opens installation and connection.
  • Open opens the selected draft for review.
  • Review again recalculates the suggestions and then opens the review.
  • Apply appears for a confirmed draft and writes its confirmed details to Kaderblick.
  • The bin deletes the draft after a confirmation prompt.

Set up the browser extension

  1. Select Browser extension in the import history.
  2. Under Installation, check which browser Kaderblick detected. Separate cards show the status for Chrome, Edge and Firefox.
  3. If an official installation link is available, select Install. In the verified demo, no installation link is published for any of the three browsers.
  4. Select Connect to Kaderblick. On the following page, start the connection with Connect extension.
  5. Then open the required fussball.de page and start the transfer in the extension.

Review an import

After the transfer, Kaderblick opens a draft. The source, number, status and count of outstanding decisions appear at the top.

  1. Use Relevant, Open, Changes, Assigned or All to show the required suggestions.
  2. Limit the view further to Teams, Players or Events. The search field filters labels within the visible suggestions.
  3. Review Assign teams & matches. Each card indicates whether Kaderblick proposes to create, update, link or leave something unchanged.
  4. Under Players by team, review player-to-team assignments. If several matches are found or no assignment exists, select the correct existing record or creation of a new record under Your decision.
  5. Review Match events in time order. Each row shows the minute, event type, player, team and proposed action; substitutions name both players.
  6. While details are missing, Kaderblick displays a warning and disables confirmation. Complete every decision labelled Details missing.
  7. Select Confirm decisions. This enables Apply.
  8. Select Apply to apply the confirmed changes. Back to overview returns to the history without applying them.

Import status

  • Draft: suggestions are still being reviewed.
  • Confirmed: all required decisions exist and the import can be applied.
  • Applied: Kaderblick has applied the confirmed information.
  • Cancelled: the draft will not be processed further.

Access and related areas

In the verified demo, the import is part of the coach navigation under match operations. Its results affect Teams, Players and Matches. The review prevents ambiguous assignments from being applied without your decision.
